IRIS.name: Bella
IRIS.direction: Interested, thoughtful student companion; stock voice casting preview, not a claimed child actor.

T01.001.speaker: SAM
T01.001.direction: 接住后递回；轻松，不夸张

T01.002.speaker: IRIS
T01.002.text: Turn it over. The other side looks different.
T01.002.direction: 她先示范自己的材料，不接管玩家

T01.003.speaker: SAM
T01.003.text: You can try things before you give them a name.
T01.003.direction: 指空展签，转身整理材料

T01.005.speaker: SAM
T01.005.text: Try this joint. It turns, but it won't hold a heavy piece.
T01.005.direction: 针对真实连接条件，演示后拆回

T01.006.speaker: IRIS
T01.006.text: Wait. Let me look before you tell me.
T01.006.direction: 玩家选择展示后才出现

T01.007.speaker: IRIS
T01.007.text: What should I look at first?
T01.007.direction: 适用于任何作品；真正询问

T01.009.speaker: IRIS
T01.009.text: Oh, I was looking at the shape. Show me the movement.
T01.009.direction: 收起首次判断，靠近但不碰

T01.010.speaker: SAM
T01.010.direction: 手伸向连接处，停在接触前

T01.012.speaker: SAM
T01.012.text: Sorry. Show me your idea first.
T01.012.direction: 手在接触前收回，等待作者实际操作，不替他接着完成

T01.013.speaker: IRIS
T01.013.text: Do you want people to understand it straight away?
T01.013.direction: 不是催作者改到可识别

T01.015.speaker: IRIS
T01.015.text: Then give them one thing to notice.
T01.015.direction: 提建议，不宣布标准答案

T01.016.speaker: SAM
T01.016.text: Where would you like to try it?

T01.018.speaker: IRIS
T01.018.text: It looks different when I'm standing here.
T01.018.direction: 观众视高；由实际视角触发

T01.019.speaker: SAM
T01.019.text: Shall I leave the title blank for now?

T01.020.speaker: NARR
T01.020.text: The empty label is still beside it. Someone has stopped to look.
T01.020.direction: 可选旁白；不替观众解释

T01.022.speaker: IRIS
T01.022.text: Let me try another angle before I answer.

T01.023.speaker: SAM
T01.023.text: Would you like a suggestion, or a little more time?
T01.023.direction: 停滞时由玩家主动请求帮助触发

T01.025.speaker: IRIS
T01.025.text: We can show it without a title.
T01.025.direction: 作者拒绝命名，也可收回作品

T01.026.speaker: SAM
T01.026.text: I'll keep the pieces together until you decide.
T01.026.direction: 仅在选择暂存后，结束当前课

T01.027.speaker: IRIS
T01.027.text: There's one empty stand by the path. What are we putting on it?
T01.027.direction: 原创补写；按实际部件、观看动作及展位触发

T01.028.speaker: SAM
T01.028.text: I saved these pieces when we cleared the workshop. Have a look.
T01.028.direction: 原创补写；按实际部件、观看动作及展位触发

T01.029.speaker: IRIS
T01.029.text: A window? I keep looking through the middle. Is that what you had in mind?
T01.029.direction: 原创补写；按实际部件、观看动作及展位触发

T01.030.speaker: IRIS
T01.030.text: A flowerpot? Wait, there's no room for a plant. What am I missing?
T01.030.direction: 原创补写；按实际部件、观看动作及展位触发

T01.031.speaker: IRIS
T01.031.text: It reminds me of a tiny tree. But you turned it this way for a reason, right?
T01.031.direction: 原创补写；按实际部件、观看动作及展位触发

T01.032.speaker: IRIS
T01.032.text: Oh! I was watching the outline. The whole shape changes when it turns.
T01.032.direction: 原创补写；按实际部件、观看动作及展位触发

T01.033.speaker: IRIS
T01.033.text: I missed that side. Now I want to walk around it before I decide what it is.
T01.033.direction: 原创补写；按实际部件、观看动作及展位触发

T01.034.speaker: IRIS
T01.034.text: All right, I won't give the answer away. I'll ask the next person what they see.
T01.034.direction: 原创补写；按实际部件、观看动作及展位触发

T01.035.speaker: SAM
T01.035.text: That ring held a flowerpot together. The pot broke, but I kept the ring.
T01.035.direction: 原创补写；按实际部件、观看动作及展位触发

T01.036.speaker: SAM
T01.036.text: I used to keep screws in that tin. They kept rolling under the bench.
T01.036.direction: 原创补写；按实际部件、观看动作及展位触发

T01.037.speaker: SAM
T01.037.text: That branch was left after the trees were pruned. Iris liked the crooked end.
T01.037.direction: 原创补写；按实际部件、观看动作及展位触发

T01.038.speaker: IRIS
T01.038.text: People coming along the path will see this side first. Let me stand where they would.
T01.038.direction: 原创补写；按实际部件、观看动作及展位触发

T01.039.speaker: IRIS
T01.039.text: Here, people can walk around it. The flowers change what I notice first.
T01.039.direction: 原创补写；按实际部件、观看动作及展位触发

T01.040.speaker: IRIS
T01.040.text: Right. I'm your first visitor. What would you like me to try?
T01.040.direction: 原创补写；按实际部件、观看动作及展位触发

T01.041.speaker: IRIS
T01.041.text: I'll wait for it to turn before I tell anyone what I see. I nearly missed the best part.
T01.041.direction: 原创补写；按实际部件、观看动作及展位触发

T01.042.speaker: IRIS
T01.042.text: I'll bring the next visitor round to this side. I wonder if we'll see the same thing.
T01.042.direction: 原创补写；按实际部件、观看动作及展位触发

T01.043.speaker: IRIS
T01.043.text: You can tell me your idea later. I want to hear what someone else sees first.
T01.043.direction: 原创补写；按实际部件、观看动作及展位触发

T01.044.speaker: IRIS
T01.044.text: I've got an old biscuit tin at home. I keep paintbrushes in it. It already has another job.
T01.044.direction: 原创补写；按实际部件、观看动作及展位触发

T01.045.speaker: SAM
T01.045.text: Then keep using it. We don't have to put everything on a stand.
T01.045.direction: 原创补写；按实际部件、观看动作及展位触发

T01.046.speaker: IRIS
T01.046.text: Will you leave me a few words for the label? Something you'd like a visitor to notice.
T01.046.direction: 原创补写；按实际部件、观看动作及展位触发

workshop.title: An idea without a name
workshop.instruments: Wooden mallets, quietly plucked strings and suspended bass

workshop_display.title: A different side
workshop_display.instruments: Sparse felt piano and slow bowed harmony
